findings.text: The company was incorporated on 1 April 2022 and is 4.6 years old.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 March 2025 and the next accounts are due 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 31 March 2026 and the next one is due 14 April 2027.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company, and no charges are registered against it.
The company has one current officer, a director, PERSON 242, appointed 1 April 2022.

One person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 243, an individual with ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent, voting rights of 75 to 100 percent, and the right to appoint and remove directors.
No red flags were identified by the rules applied to these records.
